title: NETWORKING FUNDAMENTALS
description: Test your grip on the backbone of every system: OSI layers, TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS, ARP, and the protocols that keep the net alive. Essential knowledge for any operative working below Layer 7.

links.text: Cloudflare — What is the OSI Model?

questions.question: How many layers does the OSI model have?
questions.explanation: The OSI model has 7 layers: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, and Application.

questions.question: Which protocol operates at the Network layer (Layer 3) of the OSI model?
questions.explanation: IP (Internet Protocol) operates at Layer 3. Ethernet is Layer 2, TCP is Layer 4, and HTTP is Layer 7.

questions.question: What is the default subnet mask for a Class C network?
questions.explanation: Class C networks use a /24 subnet mask: 255.255.255.0, providing up to 254 usable host addresses.

questions.question: Which port does HTTPS use by default?
questions.explanation: HTTPS uses port 443 by default. Port 80 is plain HTTP.

questions.question: What does ARP stand for?
questions.explanation: ARP — Address Resolution Protocol — maps an IP address to a MAC address on a local network segment.

questions.question: Which of the following is a private (RFC 1918) IP address range?
questions.explanation: 172.16.0.0–172.31.255.255 (/12) is one of the three RFC 1918 private ranges. 100.64.0.0/10 is CGNAT space, 169.254.0.0/16 is link-local.

questions.question: TCP uses a ____-way handshake to establish a connection.
questions.explanation: TCP uses a three-way handshake: SYN → SYN-ACK → ACK.

questions.question: Which DNS record type maps a hostname to an IPv4 address?
questions.explanation: The A record maps a hostname to an IPv4 address. AAAA maps to IPv6. CNAME is an alias. MX is for mail.

questions.question: What is the maximum size of an Ethernet frame payload (MTU)?
questions.explanation: Standard Ethernet MTU is 1500 bytes. Jumbo frames extend this to 9000 bytes but require explicit configuration.

questions.question: Which command displays the routing table on a Linux system?
questions.explanation: `ip route show` (or `ip r`) prints the kernel routing table on Linux. `netstat -r` also works but is deprecated.
